claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.rest_completion
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Arcane Recovery resolves when a Short Rest finishes, not on activation economy or elapsed-time cadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spell_slot_refund_recovery
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can consume spell slots but cannot restore chosen expended spell slots with a total recovered-level budget and per-slot maximum.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than half your Wizard level (round up), and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher.
